prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years delivering production‑grade AI agent platforms. Builds LangGraph orchestrations that ingest data, apply RAG, and generate human‑approved outputs. Designs evaluation suites, tracing with Langfuse, and secure cloud deployments using Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, Docker, and Cloudflare. Combines rapid prototyping, customer onboarding, and operational rigor from military logistics. Ensures compliance with cost caps and model selection trade‑offs.

bullets.text: Built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph system that ingested daily job postings via public APIs, scored them with RAG on pgvector, and drafted tailored documents behind a human approval step.

Enforced evidence‑cited outputs using a deterministic verify loop and layered prompt‑injection defense; added an evaluation suite with record/replay gates to ensure zero unsupported claims and pass injection tests.

Shipped the agent using FastAPI, a React/TypeScript dashboard, PostgreSQL, Langfuse tracing, a daily cost cap, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI with linting, strict typing, 70 tests, and the evaluation gate.

Built tycodes‑pipeline, a staged Python ICM pipeline that located local businesses via Google Places, audited sites, tested Google AI naming, scored AI visibility into report cards, and generated draft outreach stored in Google Sheets with human approval.
Architected and deployed linkme‑intops, an operations CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, delivering a dedicated interface for high‑value subscription accounts.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to reliably onboard high‑value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Led end‑to‑end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud‑native web infrastructure, reducing manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Constructed database‑layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Secured 50+ qualified meetings per month, exceeding a daily quota of 2, and set a record of 120+ booked meetings in one month.
Mentored and onboarded incoming representatives, helping them achieve conversion rates above 15%.
